# Rho Lall — BI Architect

> A blog for your AI. Rho Lall writes posts meant to be handed to an AI
> assistant, drawn from his work untangling accumulated data, reporting, and
> business logic for growing ecommerce and lifestyle brands.

## Start here

- [Posts](https://rholall.substack.com): the deliverable, and the front door

- [Canonical profile](https://github.com/Rho-Lall/Rho-Lall/blob/main/AGENTS.md): fuller profile, kept with the GitHub account
